title: FDA Warning Letter to Xcel Research LLC
issuing_body: U.S. Food and Drug Administration, CDER Office of Compliance
plain_language_summary: FDA warned Xcel Research that retatrutide, sermorelin, and other peptide products marketed on its website were unapproved new drugs and misbranded. The letter also states that 'research use only' labeling did not overcome the intended-use evidence.
